title: Great for Moving!
text: Great for Moving!. We've been using these bags to move my daughter back and forth from college. They're durable and strong. The handles make it easy to carry. These bags even have a little vinyl window so you can label your items. When my daughter gets moved back in at college, she can store these bags under the bed which takes up much less space than plastic tubs.

product_metadata.title: TDZWIN Moving Bags, 3 Pack Extra Large Moving Bags Heavy Duty, Easy Moving Totes Heavy Duty Moving Bags, Packing Bags for Moving With Stronger Handles, Storage Bags Moving Bags, Moving Bags forClothes
features: 🧳【Extra Large Size】-- The moving bags are 27"x 14" x 15" and up to 24 gallons of large capacity. The 24 gallons oversize moving bag can meet all your storage needs. You can use it to store children's toys, accessories, out of season clothing, blankets, towels, and other items.

🧳【Durable & 100LB Heavy Duty】-- One of the strongest moving bags in the market. TDZWIN moving bags are made of polypropylene woven material and made with premium dual zipper allowing the top to open wide for easy loading and unloading. Cross-stitched reinforced webbing handles ensure the weight-bearing capacity of the moving bag, it can hold up to 100lbs safely. Our after-sales service guarantee is up to three years.

🧳【Easy Of Use & Storage】-- Moving Bags can be carried like a tote or a backpack, we update the backpack design to help you free your hands while moving. Foldable materials fold to about the size of a book, just fold and put them away on shelves, or anywhere. The surface fabric of the moving bag is smooth and if stained, can be wiped with a wet rag or washed directly with water.

🧳【Multi-Functional Moving Bag】-- TDZWIN multi-use moving bags to be used for moving, storing, transporting, hiking, laundry, camping, traveling, organizing, space saving, under bed storage, small trips, etc. Great for storage in winter clothes, bedding, toys, closet, garage, basements, attics, or storage units. Suitable for college students or families moving.

🧳【Tag Pocket】-- Tag Pocket is specially designed for the moving bag. You can put cards in it to label the stored items or insert decorative cards or stickers to make your totes for storage look unique.
